findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name HTML/JavaScript injection via BeautifulSoup
 * @description User-controlled HTML content parsed by BeautifulSoup could contain malicious scripts
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/html-injection-beautifulsoup
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-079
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("bs4").getMember("BeautifulSoup").getACall()
select call, "BeautifulSoup constructor parsing potentially untrusted HTML/XML content."
findings.hypothesis: HTML/JavaScript injection through BeautifulSoup parsing untrusted content
